objective: Resolve remaining evidence and authorization gates without enabling unsupported empirical or regulatory claims.

sequence.blocker: No attributable NHS record identifies the actual displaced programme and complete payer/service-line context.
sequence.recommended_option: Continue public-source and disclosure-log triangulation, then record either a substantive attributable response or an explicit not-held/refused receipt.

options.rationale: Highest authority and reproducibility; independently corroborate identity, decision date, price year, and displacement.
Can obtain a definitive negative or positive response without requesting patient-level or confidential data.
Supports context and sensitivity analysis but cannot establish displacement or payer authorization.

contingencies: inaccessible: use official archive/API and emit failure receipt
conflicting: preserve all values and defer field to owner adjudication
sequence.human_stop_condition: NHS custodian response or accountable owner attestation is required before empirical promotion.

sequence.blocker: No immutable, same-programme Atlas-approved derived packet with source terms and transformations is available.
sequence.recommended_option: Use an owner-approved immutable Atlas revision with exact packet digest and source-term adjudication.

options.rationale: Preserves provenance, rights, parameter identity, and reproducibility.
Permits bounded research sensitivity only when Atlas owner accepts residual gaps.
Maintains deterministic conformance and demonstrations while all empirical claims remain disabled.

contingencies: restricted: metadata only until terms and destination are authorized
mutable: reject and request pinned revision
incomplete: do not impute mu, phi, covariance, or price
sequence.human_stop_condition: Atlas owner must approve the exact revision, derived transformations, rights, and intended use.

sequence.blocker: Empirical calibration and Scenario 4 time-profile/joint-uncertainty inputs are not authorized.
sequence.recommended_option: Retain synthetic research-only operation until packet-bound health-economist approval covers the primary discounting convention and Scenario 4 inputs.

options.rationale: Safest option; preserves executable methodology without unsupported claims.
Enables calibration only after all evidence, provenance, and authorization gates pass.
Requires a distinct sponsor, purpose, jurisdiction, validation, and release authorization.

contingencies: missing time profile: keep Scenario 4 not_identifiable
missing covariance: do not combine marginal draws
changed purpose/audience: invalidate approvals and rerun panel
sequence.human_stop_condition: Named accountable owner must authorize empirical intended use and exact packet-bound release.

refresh_rule: Any source byte, revision, terms, programme context, transformation, uncertainty, code commit, purpose, audience, or destination change invalidates dependent receipts and requires reacquisition, panel review, and requalification.
completion_rule: Do not mark T13 complete or enable empirical promotion until all three gates have authoritative evidence and packet-bound authorization.
